name: cosmic-portal

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows the portal at full glow: a bright pink ring, white core and orbiting orbs.

tagline: A glowing ring portal pulses open over a starfield you can orbit.
summary: A full 3D cosmic scene: a starry void with a luminous torus frame, circling rings and floating crystals around a bright core. A pulse and a recolour can be triggered from outside.
appearance: A tall dark panel is filled with a green-tinted starfield. A large thin ring frames a bright white core, circled by flatter pink and violet hoops, with small glowing orbs and a pale crystal near the middle. Two coloured buttons sit under the panel.
behaviour: The camera drifts and orbits slowly around the core. The rings spin and the crystals float, while Activate sends a bright pulse outward and Shift Dimensions swaps the colour scheme.
demo_content: Buttons labelled Activate Portal and Shift Dimensions; violet, blue, red and green accent colours.
use_when: A sci-fi landing page, game menu or product reveal wants a showy interactive 3D centerpiece.
avoid_when: A heavy WebGL scene with bloom that needs a fixed-height parent and a capable GPU.
customise: Colours, crystalCount, rotationSpeed, bloom strength/radius/threshold and dimensionShift are props; activate and shift are exposed through a ref.
weight_why: Full Three.js scene with bloom, FXAA, thousands of particles and a frame loop.

a11y.note: A decorative WebGL scene with no ARIA label, no keyboard orbit and no reduced-motion check.

issues: Frame 1 is so dim the portal is barely visible.
Shift Dimensions picks random colours, so it can land on clashing palettes.
polish_why: Lush bloom and a readable portal form; the narrow panel and random recolours feel demo-grade.
title: Cosmic Portal
